name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.117.0 — Citation checker resolves prose-lookback citations instead of skipping them. A citation whose preceding words name no file ("authored against § Design Canon") is now checked against the citing file plus every file in spec/doctrine, derived from the directory so a new doctrine file joins with no edit. The resolution is deliberately weak: a heading matching nothing in that union stays SKIP and can never become a MISS, because ordinary English before a section mark cannot be told apart from a real file reference and a strong resolution there would turn correct doctrine red. Repo-wide coverage goes from CHECKED=88 SKIP=104 to CHECKED=158 SKIP=34, MISS still 0; the remainder are host-generated pipeline-rules sections the checker skips by design. 7.116.0 — Citation checker verifies the whole heading name, not just the namespace prefix before the first colon. A colon no longer terminates the captured citation name, so a citation naming a section like 'Genesis: Design State' against a file whose headings are 'Genesis: Brief State' and 'Genesis: State Machine' now reports MISS instead of counting as CHECKED on the shared 'Genesis' prefix. The untruncated-window prefix check was extended to the full heading so ordinary prose continuing past a real heading name still resolves. One stale citation the widening exposed (design.md's pointer at a genesis design state that the design-stage re-chain removed) is repointed at Genesis: Brief State; MISS stays 0 repo-wide. 7.115.0 — citations-check.js resolves a path-form lookback token against the repo root instead of skipping it as not-found, and unions genesis.md into the targets for a Genesis-namespaced heading whose lookback names another file — eight previously unchecked doctrine citations now verify, and the live corpus stays at MISS=0.
